mapper.select: SELECT id, resource_type, resource_name, provider, period_start, period_end, amount, currency, allocation_method, allocated_amount, request_count, demo_flag, remark, created_at FROM ai_infrastructure_cost ORDER BY period_start DESC, resource_type ASC

SELECT id, resource_type, resource_name, provider, period_start, period_end, amount, currency, allocation_method, allocated_amount, request_count, demo_flag, remark, created_at FROM ai_infrastructure_cost WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_infrastructure_cost (resource_type, resource_name, provider, period_start, period_end, amount, currency, allocation_method, allocated_amount, request_count, demo_flag, remark) VALUES (#{resourceType}, #{resourceName}, #{provider}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{allocationMethod}, #{allocatedAmount}, #{requestCount}, #{demoFlag}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_infrastructure_cost SET resource_name = #{resourceName}, provider = #{provider}, period_start = #{periodStart}, period_end = #{periodEnd}, amount = #{amount}, allocation_method = #{allocationMethod}, demo_flag = #{demoFlag}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM ai_infrastructure_cost WHERE period_start <= #{end} AND period_end >= #{start}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(allocated_amount), 0) FROM ai_infrastructure_cost WHERE period_start <= #{end} AND period_end >= #{start}
